website.note: Healthcare services / DME provider; no clinical pipeline page exists.

commercial_product.description: InfuSystem is a national healthcare services and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) provider. It rents, sells, and services ambulatory and pole-mounted infusion pumps; provides clinic-to-home oncology continuous infusion, pain management (peripheral nerve block), and wound care (NPWT, advanced wound care dressings, pneumatic compression devices); and runs biomedical recertification, maintenance, and repair Centers of Excellence in the US and Canada.
key_relationships: Sanara MedTech (SI Healthcare partnership for advanced wound care distribution)
Smith and Nephew, Cork Medical, Genadyne Biotechnologies (NPWT device manufacturers serviced)
ChemoMouthpiece, LLC (exclusive distribution via SI Healthcare for oral mucositis product)
commercial_product.rd_disclosure: Company explicitly states: 'We do not perform any research and development on pumps' (10-K Overview). Investment is in IT systems (EXPRESS, InfuBus, InfuConnect, DeviceHub, BlockPain Dashboard, TIM).

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: InfuSystem is a healthcare services and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) provider that rents, sells, and services infusion pumps and related products for outpatient oncology, pain management, and wound care. The 10-K explicitly states the Company does not perform R&D on pumps, and ClinicalTrials.gov returns zero sponsored studies. No proprietary drug, biologic, or device development pipeline.
